task.title: Correct provider-tool task turns
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/585 by preserving caller-owned correction lineage across bounded provider/tool task turns and persisting final provider text as linked Correction evidence only.
acceptance_criteria: Expose correction-specific initial and continuation operations with typed outcomes.
Retain the caller-owned parent Attempt identity across non-terminal tool steps.
Persist final provider content as an exact linked Correction without adding an Attempt or changing task lifecycle state.
Preserve existing transcript, identity, lineage, permission, partial-commit, and race semantics.

attempts.summary: Established RED for direct and continued correction turns.
attempts.diagnostic: ToolAssistantRuntime lacked correction-specific outcomes and operations capable of retaining parent Attempt lineage through provider/tool continuations.
attempts.patch: Added focused failing tests for direct correction finalization, correction after a tool step, and invalid parent lineage.

attempts.diagnostic: Correction-specific continuations retain the parent Attempt identity while reusing the bounded observation runtime path; finalization appends linked Correction evidence only.
attempts.patch: Added correction outcomes, continuations, initial and continuation methods, durable integration coverage, and runtime documentation.

attempts.summary: Generalized the observation bridge without changing behavior.
attempts.diagnostic: Attempt and Correction turns shared provider/tool sequencing, but final observation persistence still contained duplicate initial and continuation blocks.
attempts.patch: Generalized the private observation execution bridge; recorded the remaining final-persistence duplication as follow-up issue 587 after substantive review.

attempts.summary: Verified exact head and merged after review capacity returned.
attempts.diagnostic: Focused correction tests, pinned verification, and independent review passed. Rust quality gate run 30156238786 succeeded; after a false-green rate limit, substantive CodeRabbit review completed on exact head and the non-blocking duplication finding was durably tracked.
attempts.patch: Pull request 586 squash-merged as 57d1bfcb81c33d926ebacd5915ba3a9b984e157b and closed issue 585.

outcome.summary: Provider-tool task turns now retain caller-owned correction lineage across explicit tool steps and durably append final provider content as linked Correction evidence without adding Attempts or lifecycle transitions.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo test -p vela-kernel --test tool_task_runtime correction_ --locked
Independent pre-commit review # no blocking findings
GitHub Rust quality gate https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/actions/runs/30156238786 and substantive CodeRabbit review at https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/pull/586

lessons: Correction lineage is caller-owned terminal intent and belongs in a typed continuation rather than provider output.
Final correction text is evidence linked to an existing Attempt; it must not create a new Attempt or imply a lifecycle transition.
A valid non-blocking review finding should become a bounded durable follow-up instead of expanding an already complete behavior slice.
A rate-limited green review status is not substantive review evidence.
